title: ExplainVector
description: Published by the XAI module to retail/explain/{product_id} after a price decision. QoS 1, not retained. May arrive seconds after the PriceUpdate it explains, or not at all if SHAP computation fails. Consumers must treat a price without an explanation as a valid state.

decision_id.description: Matches the decision_id of the PriceUpdate this explains.

base_value.description: SHAP expected value: the model output before any feature contribution. base_value + sum(shap[].value) equals the decided price, to within half a cent.

shap.description: Signed feature contributions, sorted by absolute value descending. The vector must be COMPLETE, not a truncated top-N: a model with more than 20 features aggregates its tail into a single entry named 'other_factors' rather than dropping it, so additivity always holds. A consumer that receives a non-additive vector must surface the unexplained remainder rather than hide it — silently folding it away would defeat the audit claim this project rests on.

feature.description: snake_case feature name. The dashboard maps these to plain-language labels; add new names here and to that map in the same PR.

value.description: Contribution in currency units. Negative pushes price down, positive pushes it up.
